title_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit , Shitet Apartament 1+1+Verande Totalisht I Investuar!!!
description_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Apartament 1+1+Verande Totalisht I Investuar!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin 1 banim te nje pallati me 10 kate, te mireadministruar me ashensor dhe ka siperfaqe bruto 76.7 m2 nga te cilat 54.5 m2 siperfaqe neto dhe 17.7 m2 siperfaqe verande. Organizohet ne sallonin ndenjes me kendin e gatimit, 1 dhome gjumi, 1 tualet dhe 1 verande. Prona eshte totalisht e investuar me te gjitha instalimet e reja elektrike dhe hidraulike, eshte nje mundesi ideale si per banim edhe per investim sepse ndodhet ne katin 1 banim dhe mund te pershtatet shume lehte si per zyra ashtu edhe per klinika : dentare, estetike, laborator mjekesor, etj. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet prona eshte nje nga zonat me te preferuara te Tiranes. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote dhe te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Apartment 1+1+Verandah Totally Invested!!!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Apartment 1+1+Verandah Totally Invested!!! The apartment is located on the 1st residential floor of a 10-story building, well-managed with an elevator, and has a gross area of ​​76.7 m2, of which 54.5 m2 is a net area and 17.7 m2 is a veranda area. It is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and 1 veranda. The property is fully invested with all new electrical and plumbing installations, it is an ideal opportunity for both residence and investment because it is located on the 1st residential floor and can be easily adapted for both offices and clinics: dental, aesthetic, medical laboratory, etc. The area in which the property is located is one of the most favorite areas of Tirana. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
